title: Mood Rating
description: A daily check-in whose big face morphs continuously with the carousel's `progress`.
steps: Five faces sit in a `loop={false}` carousel with `itemSize` 86 and `defaultIndex` 3; `itemAnimation` scales the centered face to 1.15 and fades its neighbors to 0.55 and 0.3.
The `progress` shared value drives the big face on the UI thread: mouth curve, eye height, brow tilt, blush, tear, face color and background are all interpolated from it.
Until the first touch, `autoplay` every 1600 ms ping-pongs by flipping `autoplayDirection` at both ends; tapping a small face calls `scrollTo({ index })`.
